message.content:
The **login page** for PreLicenseTraining is the account login at PreLicenseTraining.com, where you enter your login name and password.[1] The site notes that your login name may be your email address.[1]

If you’re having trouble signing in, there is also a **forgot password** page where you can enter your email address to receive reset instructions.[6]

If you want, I can also help you find the **sign-up** page or the correct portal for a specific partner school like Infinity Schools or PSI Learning Academy.[2][4]
